description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Moragollagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0193)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters, specifically declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner names, property extents, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category definition.
